name: product-manual-automation
description: Generate evidence-backed Markdown product manuals for WeChat Mini Programs and desktop web applications.

interface.shortDescription: Build reviewed Markdown manuals from source and runtime evidence.
interface.longDescription: Scans WeChat Mini Program and desktop web projects, reconstructs user operations, records source/runtime/database evidence, produces privacy-safe annotated screenshots, and renders strictly validated Markdown manuals.
defaultPrompt: Generate a function-first product manual for this project.
Audit and incrementally update the existing product manual.
Open the screenshot review queue and resolve pending items.
